title: Button on(keyPress) event — model, FLA import, SWF emit
description: ButtonHandler event union has no keyPress variant; on(keyPress '<key>') handlers are silently dropped in flash8-import.ts; buttons.ts has no key-press condition bits in eventBitMap. Fix: add KeyPress variant to ButtonHandler, import it from FLA, and emit ButtonActionCondition KEY_PRESS bits (bits 9-15 = ASCII char) in DefineButton2. Ruffle supports this fully.
